what: Independent reproduction of sim1_transition.py's family by a separate agent with its own code (2026-10-08): polar-areal, flux form, 4th-order differences, numba, constraints re-solved each RK stage, 6th-order dissipation; same physics and initial data (phi = p exp(-((r-20)/3)^2), ingoing). Its scratch code is not kept; these are its reported numbers.
flat_control: p = 1e-6, error vs exact: 4th order (3.8-4.01) down to h = 0.025; at p = 1e-8 order 4.00-4.01 at every level

p_star.criterion: max 2m/r >= 0.99 by t = 100, or not dispersed (alpha(0) > 0.9 and max 2m/r < 0.05 on r < 10 at t >= 50)
p_star.note: agree on p* = 0.01688 to 4 significant figures; the 5th digit is resolution-dependent; classifier non-monotone below ~1e-6 relative

convergence_p_0.8pstar: 4th order (factor ~16) except Phi near the origin during the bounce (order ~3.3) and late at the outer boundary
unresolved: a NaN in the 2m/r scan is counted as a black hole (one run, above the bracket; p* unaffected)
